component.name: observability-demo
component.description: Enterprise-grade polyglot microservice observability platform with synthetic canary load generator, fault injection drills, container lifecycle control, SQL data grid, and cross-platform mobile client.

components.name: observability-python-app
components.description: Python Flask microservice featuring custom recursive-descent math evaluator, Fibonacci compute, PostgreSQL audit logging, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

properties.name: implementation
properties.value: Built with Python 3.11-slim, Flask WSGI framework, psycopg2-binary for relational PostgreSQL connection pooling, and OpenTelemetry Python SDK (opentelemetry-api, opentelemetry-sdk, opentelemetry-instrumentation-flask, opentelemetry-exporter-otlp) exporting metrics and traces via gRPC to otel-collector.

properties.name: inspiration
properties.value: Inspired by Armin Ronacher's Flask micro-framework architecture, PEP 3333 WSGI standards, and Dijkstra's Shunting-yard algorithm / Pratt parsing for mathematical expression tokenization and AST evaluation without relying on eval().

components.name: observability-java-app
components.description: High-performance Java 21 Spring Boot microservice with native Actuator health metrics, custom Pratt-parser math evaluator, and automated JavaAgent OpenTelemetry tracing.

properties.name: implementation
properties.value: Built on Eclipse Temurin JDK 21 Alpine, Spring Boot 3.2.0, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA / HikariCP connection pool for PostgreSQL, and opentelemetry-javaagent-1.32.0 for zero-code bytecode instrumentation correlated with Spring Actuator micrometer Prometheus exports.

properties.name: inspiration
properties.value: Inspired by the Spring Boot PetClinic reference architecture, Spring Framework's inversion of control (IoC) and dependency injection patterns, and enterprise Java fault tolerance practices popularized by Netflix Hystrix / Resilience4j.

components.name: observability-rust-app
components.description: Ultra-fast, memory-safe asynchronous Rust microservice utilizing Tokio and Axum with zero-dependency mathematical evaluation and tracing-opentelemetry subscribers.

properties.name: implementation
properties.value: Written in Rust 1.77 using Tokio async runtime, Axum web framework, Tower middleware, sqlx for asynchronous PostgreSQL queries, and tracing / tracing-opentelemetry subscriber pipeline streaming directly to otel-collector via OTLP gRPC.

properties.name: inspiration
properties.value: Inspired by Tokio's work-stealing multi-threaded reactor pattern, Carl Lerche's async I/O design principles, and Rust's zero-cost abstraction philosophy guaranteeing fearless concurrency and data-race freedom.

components.name: observability-node-app
components.description: Event-driven Node.js Express microservice featuring recursive-descent math tokenizer, pg connection pool, and OpenTelemetry Node SDK.

properties.name: implementation
properties.value: Engineered in Node.js 22 LTS with Express 4.19, pg (node-postgres) connection pool, and @opentelemetry/sdk-node integrating OTLP gRPC metric and trace exporters.

properties.name: inspiration
properties.value: Inspired by Ryan Dahl's original Node.js event-loop architecture, TJ Holowaychuk's Express middleware pipeline, and 12-factor microservice design patterns.

components.name: observability-go-app
components.description: Concurrent Go microservice using idiomatic net/http, Goroutines, pgx/v5 PostgreSQL driver, and OpenTelemetry Go SDK.

properties.name: implementation
properties.value: Developed in Go 1.22 using the standard library net/http server, pgx/v5 connection pool, and go.opentelemetry.io/otel SDK with grpc OTLP exporters for distributed tracing and Prometheus-compatible metrics.

properties.name: inspiration
properties.value: Inspired by Rob Pike and Ken Thompson's Communicating Sequential Processes (CSP) concurrency model, Go standard library minimalism, and Google's internal microservice guidelines.

components.name: observability-dotnet-app
components.description: Modern C# .NET 8.0 Linux containerized microservice using ASP.NET Core Minimal APIs, Npgsql, and OpenTelemetry .NET SDK.

properties.name: implementation
properties.value: Constructed with .NET 8.0 SDK / ASP.NET Core Minimal APIs, Npgsql ADO.NET data provider, System.Text.Json, and OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Hosting with OTLP gRPC export.

properties.name: inspiration
properties.value: Inspired by Microsoft ASP.NET Core Minimal API architecture (David Fowler), high-performance Kestrel web server design, and modern cross-platform .NET runtime on Linux containers.

components.name: observability-c-app
components.description: Pure POSIX C99 microservice implementing raw non-blocking socket HTTP parsing, recursive descent evaluator, and libpq PostgreSQL queries.

properties.name: implementation
properties.value: Implemented in C99 with POSIX Berkeley sockets, pthreads, libpq (PostgreSQL C client library), cJSON, and custom HTTP request parser without heavy web server dependencies.

properties.name: inspiration
properties.value: Inspired by W. Richard Stevens' 'UNIX Network Programming', Dennis Ritchie's foundational C philosophy, and embedded micro-HTTP servers (like mongoose and civetweb).

components.name: observability-canary
components.description: Synthetic traffic generator, Chaos Fault Injection coordinator, Docker lifecycle controller, PostgreSQL query engine, and real-time operations dashboard.

properties.name: implementation
properties.value: Python 3.11 service with standard library HTTPServer, Unix domain socket Docker Engine API client, psycopg2-binary PostgreSQL client, Valkey Redis client, OpenTelemetry SDK, qrcode SVG engine, and HTML5 Canvas dashboard with first-principles data grid.

properties.name: inspiration
properties.value: Inspired by Netflix Simian Army (Chaos Monkey), AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS), Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), pgAdmin 4 data grid design, and Google Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) synthetic probing practices.

components.name: canary-observability-mobile
components.description: Cross-platform mobile and desktop application for Android, iOS, Windows, and Web monitoring Canary telemetry and controlling container power.

properties.name: implementation
properties.value: React Native 0.74, Expo 51, React 18, React Native for Web, and React Native Windows with responsive Flexbox layout and dark theme UI matching the Canary operations center.

properties.name: inspiration
properties.value: Inspired by modern DevOps mobile command centers (Datadog Mobile, PagerDuty, Grafana Mobile, AWS Console Mobile) providing remote on-call triage and chaos response.

properties.name: role

properties.name: inspiration

properties.name: role

properties.name: inspiration

properties.name: role

properties.name: inspiration
properties.value: Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) merger of OpenTracing and OpenCensus.

properties.name: role

properties.name: inspiration

properties.name: inspiration

components.description: Operational visualization and dashboarding platform providing correlated dashboards across metrics, logs, and traces.

properties.name: role
